description: Tool to confirm customer intent to pay with current or provided payment method. Use when ready to finalize a PaymentIntent and initiate the payment attempt. A return_url is required if confirmation needs customer action like 3D Secure authentication.

inputSchema.description: Request model for confirming a PaymentIntent.

capture_method.description: Controls fund capture timing. Can be 'automatic', 'automatic_async' (default), or 'manual'.
capture_method.title: Capture Method

confirmation_token.description: ID of the ConfirmationToken to use for confirmation.
confirmation_token.title: Confirmation Token

error_on_requires_action.description: When true, fails payment if PaymentIntent transitions to 'requires_action'. Default is false.
error_on_requires_action.title: Error On Requires Action

mandate.description: ID of the mandate to use for this payment.
mandate.title: Mandate

off_session.description: Set to true to indicate customer is not in checkout flow, or use 'one_off' or 'recurring' for specific off-session types.
off_session.title: Off Session

payment_intent_id.description: The ID of the PaymentIntent to confirm.
payment_intent_id.title: Payment Intent Id

payment_method.description: ID of the PaymentMethod to attach to this PaymentIntent.
payment_method.title: Payment Method

payment_method_data.description: Hash to create new PaymentMethod with type-specific details. Must include 'type' field (e.g., 'card', 'acss_debit', etc.).
payment_method_data.title: Payment Method Data

payment_method_options.description: Payment method-specific configuration (e.g., card installments, 3D Secure, BNPL options).
payment_method_options.title: Payment Method Options

return_url.description: The URL to redirect your customer back to after they authenticate or cancel their payment. Required if confirmation requires customer action (e.g., 3D Secure).
return_url.title: Return Url

setup_future_usage.description: Indicates intent to reuse payment method. Use 'on_session' if customer is present, 'off_session' for future charges.
setup_future_usage.title: Setup Future Usage

use_stripe_sdk.description: Set to true when confirming client-side with Stripe.js or mobile SDKs.
use_stripe_sdk.title: Use Stripe Sdk
